stages.effectText: This unit can designate one Tactical Point within attack range to call Reinforcements ; Reinforcements take 15% less damage from units they are blocking, and this unit's ATK is increased to 150% when attacking enemies blocked by Reinforcements

Can summon a Flowing Shape to assist in combat. Flowing Shapes can partially copy an undeployed Operator 's attributes (Max HP, ATK, DEF, RES, Block Count, Attack Interval, Attack Range, Damage Type, ability of obtaining a special trait depending on whether in melee or ranged form), gains 5 SP immediately after first deployment, and will respawn 25 seconds after being defeated.

Can summon a Flowing Shape to assist in combat. Flowing Shapes can copy all of an undeployed Operator's attributes (Max HP, ATK, DEF, RES, Block Count, Attack Interval, Attack Range, Damage Type, ability of obtaining a special trait depending on whether in melee or ranged form), gains 5 SP immediately after first deployment, and will respawn 25 seconds after being defeated.
